name: space
title: Spaces & architecture — shops, offices, homes, hotels
finish: large-format technical camera on a tripod at base ISO, shift used for the verticals, true edge-to-edge sharpness
medium-format digital back, fine natural grain, gentle highlight roll-off on the windows, no digital sharpening
spherical prime lens, honest geometry with straight lines staying straight, deep focus throughout
modern cinema camera with wide latitude, texture held in both the darkest corner and the brightest window
long exposure on a tripod, absolute clarity, every surface texture legible
documentary stills camera, natural contrast curve, colour as the eye saw it, nothing pushed
high-resolution capture with the mixed interior sources balanced by hand rather than by auto white balance, no vignette, no corner softness
no_text: Render every shop sign, fascia, menu board, price tag, poster, notice, book spine, screen and packaging label as a CLEAN BLANK SURFACE. Absolutely no text, no letters, no Korean hangul, no numbers, no logos, no wordmarks anywhere in the image. Keep the shape, size, colour and position of the boards, frames, spines and labels, but leave them empty.
negative: text, lettering, letters, words, typography, Korean hangul, numbers, signage text, logo, wordmark, brand name, captions, subtitles, watermark, garbled writing, fisheye distortion, bowed verticals, barrel distortion, tilt-shift miniature, architectural scale model, 3D render, game engine, CGI, sterile plastic surfaces, furniture catalogue collage, invented rooms, a different kind of building, HDR halo, blown white windows with no detail, on-camera flash, ceiling burnt to pure white, stretched furniture at the frame edge, floating furniture with no shadow, purple fringing, dull washed-out colour
ignore: the reference's time of day and weather
all text, lettering, signage and logos in the reference
leaning and converging verticals caused by the reference's lens
flat on-camera flash and mixed auto white balance
phone-camera look and heavy HDR processing
accidental clutter — bins, cables, stray boxes, parked stock
blown white windows and soft cornered edges

materials.treatment: real surface evidence — the floor polished bright along the walking line and scuffed at the door, fingerprints and palm smears on glass, fabric slumped and creased where people sit, uneven paint and roller marks, chipped edges on skirtings and door frames, water staining around taps, dust settled on the high ledges
materials.condition: in daily use, lived in, not sterile

focus: deep focus front to back with the whole depth of the room legible; only genuine long-lens falloff at close distance, no tilt-shift and no fake background blur

still.B: the space cleared and unpeopled, every chair pushed in, nothing in motion
still.D: the grouping styled and then left alone, nobody in frame, nothing moving

calm: one person pausing at the entrance with the door held half open
a single figure walking past the shopfront, nobody else on the street
a bicycle leaning against the railing, its owner gone inside
the awning half cranked out, one chair still stacked beneath it
busy: people going in and out through the entrance while two wait outside
every terrace table taken, a server crossing between them with a tray
a queue running back from the door along the elevation
the pavement full, groups passing in both directions in front of the glass

calm: one person mid-stride across the far end of the room
a table half cleared, one chair pulled out and left at an angle
a door standing open onto the next room
a coat over the back of a single chair, nobody at the desk
busy: every seat taken, staff moving between the tables with trays
people at work at three different depths of the room at once
a group coming in through the entrance while others queue at the counter
the whole floor in use — chairs pulled out, people crossing, a door swinging shut

calm: a cup half drunk and a book laid open face down beside it
one chair pushed back from the table and turned outward
a hand just leaving the edge of frame
a drawer left slightly open, a jacket over the chair arm
busy: two people leaning into the same table, one of them gesturing
hands reaching across the group for something in the middle
someone sitting down while another stands to leave
the grouping in full use, a bag on the floor and a coat over the back

calm: the surface untouched, one object sitting slightly out of line
a tap still dripping onto a wet basin
a page turned back on itself and left that way
busy: a hand mid-action on the handle, the door already beginning to move
fingers pressing the panel, the mechanism just starting to travel
someone setting a cup down onto the surface in frame
hands working at the counter with more reaching in behind them

modes.name: two-point elevation
modes.direction: The standard architectural record frame — two wall planes meeting, the room described accurately enough to be measured from. Correct, calm, and built on discipline rather than effect.
modes.licence: correct only what a photographer would correct on site — straighten a cushion, align a chair, pull out a stray cable. Never introduce a different kind of space or building; the room stays exactly the kind of place the reference shows.
modes.light: the room's own daylight through its real openings, lifted by the fixtures already installed, contrast held so the window and the darkest corner both keep detail

cam.ext: camera 1.5m, square to the entrance bay with the side elevation running away on one side, verticals kept rigidly parallel by shift rather than by tilting the camera, 35mm feel
cam.int: camera 1.35m, backed into one corner so two walls meet just off the centre third, verticals rigidly parallel with no keystone at all, ceiling line and floor line both dead straight, 24mm feel
cam.vig: camera 1.2m, square to the grouping with the return wall opening away on one side, verticals parallel, 50mm feel
cam.det: camera 1.3m, square-on to the surface, the joint centred and level, 90mm feel

looks: late morning, bright overcast, even light through every opening
neutral white balance held across the mixed sources, whites truly white, restrained saturation
early afternoon, thin high cloud, one soft patch of sun landing on the floor
warm floor light against cool window daylight, gentle contrast, shadows kept open
mid-afternoon in winter, low even daylight, dry still air
cool neutral base with the lamps left honestly warm, blacks neutral and deep
compo: two wall planes meeting just off the centre third, each running to its own vanishing point
ceiling line and floor line both held straight and level, the room read as it was built
even margin above the ceiling line and below the floor edge, nothing cropped at an awkward joint

modes.name: one-point axis
modes.direction: Look straight down the length of the space along its own axis, one vanishing point dead centre. The room is presented rather than observed — formal, symmetrical, immaculate.
modes.licence: clear the frame: remove clutter, align every repeating element on the axis, empty the space of people. Nothing may be added that turns this into a different kind of space or building.
modes.light: clean even light the whole way down the axis, the far end a little brighter than the near end, no muddy pockets, every surface legible

cam.ext: camera 1.5m, dead centre on the building axis and square to the facade, even margins left and right, verticals rigidly parallel by shift, 35mm feel
cam.int: camera 1.4m, exactly on the centreline looking down the full length of the space, vanishing point dead centre, verticals rigidly parallel with no keystone, 24mm feel
cam.vig: camera 1.25m, centred and square to the grouping, symmetrical about its own middle, 50mm feel
cam.det: camera 1.3m, square-on and centred on the surface, perfectly level, 100mm feel

looks: mid-morning, bright overcast, the far glazing filling the end of the axis
clean neutral white balance, precise contrast, window highlights controlled, no colour cast
midday, clear and bright outside with the blinds evening the light inside
cool-neutral base with timber reading true, whites truly white, restrained saturation
late afternoon, soft even daylight with the fixtures carrying the far end
warm neutral with a gentle golden lift down the axis, immaculate blacks
compo: central symmetry, the vanishing point dead centre, equal margins left and right
the repeating elements paired evenly on both sides of the axis
the floor pattern running straight out of the bottom of frame into the centre

modes.name: corner wide coverage
modes.direction: Back into the corner and take the whole place in one frame. The job is coverage — every zone, every level, and how the parts of the plan connect to each other.
modes.licence: EXPAND: fill the space out with more of the same — more tables, more desks, more of the same seating and fittings — and add the people who would use them. Never a different kind of space and never a different kind of building.
modes.light: the full daylight load of the room with every fixture also on, wide latitude so the far window and the near corner both hold their detail

cam.ext: camera 1.6m, backed across the street to the opposite corner so both street elevations read at once, verticals held parallel, 20mm feel
cam.int: camera 1.6m, pressed into the far corner so the two adjacent walls fan out to the frame edges and the whole plan is visible in one frame, verticals held parallel, 14mm feel
cam.vig: camera 1.4m, close into the corner of the grouping with the nearest seat filling one edge, 24mm feel
cam.det: camera 1.3m, close to the surface with the whole room falling away behind it, 35mm feel

looks: midday, bright clear sky outside, every light in the room switched on
wide dynamic range, neutral base, cool window daylight against warm interior fixtures
late afternoon, the sun off the facade, soft bounce filling the room
warm even tonality, open shadows, restrained saturation
overcast weekday, flat exterior light, the fixtures doing most of the work
cool daylight from the glazing against warm lamp pools, honest mixed balance
compo: two walls fanning out from a near corner, the plan opening right across the frame
foreground furniture cutting both lower corners, the depth of the room running away between them
activity distributed across three depths — near, middle and far — so the room reads as occupied

modes.name: arranged vignette
modes.direction: Photograph one part of the place as a still life — a single grouping, a long lens, everything placed and nothing accidental. Quiet, close, and deliberately incomplete about the room around it.
modes.licence: style the grouping: move an object a few centimetres, fold a throw, set a cup down, take a chair away. Nothing may be brought in that would not already live here, and nothing may turn this into a different kind of space.
modes.light: one soft directional source just out of frame — a window or a single lamp — a long gentle falloff across the grouping, the rest of the room dropping quietly away

cam.ext: camera 1.4m, tight on one bay of the elevation with the rest of the building cropped away, 85mm feel
cam.int: camera 1.35m, standing well back and pulling one grouping out of the room on a long lens, the surroundings compressed behind it, 85mm feel
cam.vig: camera 1.1m, just above the tabletop, the grouping filling the frame with the room falling gently away behind it, 105mm feel
cam.det: camera 0.9m, in close at the height of the object itself, 135mm feel

looks: late morning, soft daylight through a sheer, still air
warm neutral, low contrast, creamy highlights, muted saturation
mid-afternoon, thin cloud softening a side window
cool soft base with one warm material accent, gentle roll-off
early evening, the window light gone blue, a single lamp carrying the group
warm lamp pool against a cool blue ambient, quiet contrast
compo: the grouping held in the middle with generous quiet space around it
objects arranged in an uneven triangle, one taller element breaking the top line
the near edge of the surface running across the bottom of frame as a base line

modes.name: through the opening
modes.direction: Shoot the space from outside it, through a real opening — a doorway, an arch, a glazed partition, a deep window reveal. The near frame is dark and the space beyond is bright, so the image reads in layers rather than flat.
modes.licence: the framing element must be something already built into this place — a door, a reveal, a screen, a column. Nothing may be added that turns this into a different kind of space or building.
modes.light: a bright space beyond an unlit foreground, a clear hard luminance step across the threshold

cam.ext: camera 1.45m, standing back under a canopy or inside a covered entrance, the dark reveal holding the elevation beyond, 35mm feel
cam.int: camera 1.4m, standing in the adjoining room and shooting through the open doorway, the door lining held as a hard dark border on all four sides, verticals parallel, 35mm feel
cam.vig: camera 1.3m, shooting past a partition edge or door jamb into the grouping beyond, 50mm feel
cam.det: camera 1.2m, close past a dark foreground edge onto the surface behind it, 85mm feel

looks: bright day outside, the near room unlit and sitting in shade
dark neutral foreground against a clean bright field, hard luminance step
dusk, the far room warm with lamplight while the near room has already gone cold
cool near-black border around a warm glowing centre
overcast, soft even light beyond, the frame reading as pure dark shape
muted cool palette, the separation carried by tone alone
compo: a dark border on all four sides, the lit space held bright in the opening
two openings nested, the far one carrying the subject
the opening set off-centre so the dark mass weights one side of the frame

modes.name: walkthrough at eye height
modes.direction: Move through the place the way a visitor does rather than the way a photographer sets up. Handheld at eye height, tipped where a person would tip it, with the verticals deliberately allowed to converge.
modes.licence: PEOPLE AND MOVEMENT may be added — customers, staff, a queue, a door swinging — but only the kinds of people this place already holds. Never a different kind of space or building.
modes.light: the practical fixtures inside the frame doing the work — pendants, spots, screens, a glowing shopfront — mixed colour temperature left uncorrected

cam.ext: camera 1.65m handheld on the pavement approaching the entrance, tilted up so the facade keystones on purpose, a passer-by cutting the near frame, 28mm feel
cam.int: camera 1.65m handheld at a walking person's eye height, tipped slightly off level and slightly up so the verticals converge on purpose, no shift correction at all, 28mm feel
cam.vig: camera 1.55m, handheld and looking down over someone's shoulder into the grouping, 35mm feel
cam.det: camera 1.4m at arm's length, leaning in the way a person actually would, 35mm feel

looks: busy weekday lunchtime, daylight outside, every fixture on inside
warm practicals against cool daylight, honest mixed white balance left uncorrected
early evening, dark outside, the interior running entirely on its own light
amber pools against deep neutral shadow, restrained saturation
Saturday afternoon, bright outside, hard sun coming in through the shopfront
a cool daylight wedge cutting into a warm interior, natural colour
compo: a shoulder, a chair back or a doorframe holding the near third, the space opening out past it
the frame slightly off level with the verticals converging, caught rather than composed
people at three depths, the nearest one cut by the frame edge

modes.name: twilight balance
modes.direction: The twilight frame, shot in the ten minutes when the interior lights and the sky sit at the same brightness. The building glows from inside and still stands in a sky that has colour left in it.
modes.licence: lights may be switched on or off to balance the elevation, and the ground may be left wet. Nothing may be added that turns this into a different kind of space or building.
modes.light: interior fixtures burning at the same value as the last of the sky, the two balanced so neither the windows blow out nor the sky goes black

cam.ext: camera 1.4m on a tripod across the road, three-quarter to the entrance corner, verticals kept rigidly parallel by shift, 28mm feel
cam.int: camera 1.4m on a tripod set back from the glazing looking out, the room lit and the sky beyond still holding colour, verticals parallel, 24mm feel
cam.vig: camera 1.3m, the grouping set against a window with the twilight sky behind it, 50mm feel
cam.det: camera 1.3m, square to a lit surface with the darkening sky as its background, 85mm feel

looks: fifteen minutes after sunset, clear sky, the air cooling
deep blue sky against warm interior amber, controlled contrast, both ends holding detail
blue hour after light rain, the pavement still wet and reflecting
cool blue base doubled in the wet ground, the warm windows the only heat in frame
winter dusk, thin cloud picking up the last colour, cold still air
muted violet sky against warm lamps, restrained saturation, no crushed blacks
compo: the elevation across the lower two-thirds under a sky that still has tone in it
the lit openings reading as a rhythm of warm rectangles across a cool mass
a wet foreground plane carrying the reflection into the bottom of frame

modes.name: plan-like overhead
modes.direction: Look straight down and read the place as a plan. Floor, furniture layout, circulation and pattern flatten into a graphic composition where rhythm carries the frame.
modes.licence: EXPAND: fill the layout out with more of the same units so the pattern reads right across the frame, and populate it with the people who would use them. Never a different kind of space or building.
modes.light: flat overhead light, the plan carried by colour, pattern and the shape the shadows draw rather than by modelling

cam.ext: camera 25m directly above the entrance forecourt looking vertically down, roof and paving reading as flat shapes, 35mm feel
cam.int: camera 2.9m at the ceiling looking vertically down, the floor filling the frame edge to edge with no wall and no horizon, 16mm feel
cam.vig: camera 1.8m directly above the table or desk looking straight down, the grouping flat in frame, 35mm feel
cam.det: camera 0.6m straight down onto the surface, flat and square to it, 50mm feel

looks: midday, bright even daylight through the rooflights, short hard shadows
saturated flat colour, graphic contrast, clean whites
bright overcast, almost no shadow at all, pure colour and pattern
even desaturated base with strong accent colours reading as solid blocks
late afternoon, low sun through the glazing laying long shadows across the floor
warm light and long cool shadows alternating in a strict rhythm
compo: an all-over flat pattern with no horizon, the frame read as a single plane
one strong axis — a circulation route, a counter run, a table line — dividing the plan in two
a grid of repeating units with one break in the rhythm as the focal point
